title: Amazon Secrets Manager Secret
description: Schema representing a secret managed by Amazon Secrets Manager, including metadata, rotation configuration, tags, and version staging information.

ARN.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the secret.

Name.description: The friendly name of the secret.

Description.description: The user-provided description of the secret.

KmsKeyId.description: The ARN, key ID, or alias of the AWS KMS key used to encrypt the secret.

RotationEnabled.description: Indicates whether automatic rotation is enabled for this secret.

RotationLambdaARN.description: The ARN of the AWS Lambda function invoked to rotate the secret.

RotationRules.description: The rotation schedule and window configuration.

AutomaticallyAfterDays.description: The number of days between automatic scheduled rotations of the secret.

Duration.description: The length of the rotation window in hours (e.g., 3h).

ScheduleExpression.description: A cron() or rate() expression that defines the schedule for rotating the secret.

LastRotatedDate.description: The most recent date and time that the secret rotation was triggered.

LastChangedDate.description: The last date and time that this secret was modified in any way.

LastAccessedDate.description: The last date that this secret was accessed.

DeletedDate.description: The date and time the deletion of the secret occurred, if scheduled.

Tags.description: The list of tags attached to the secret.

Key.description: The key identifier or name of the tag.

Value.description: The string value associated with the key of the tag.

SecretVersionsToStages.description: A mapping of version IDs to the list of staging labels attached to each version.

OwningService.description: The name of the AWS service that created this secret.

CreatedDate.description: The date and time when the secret was created.

PrimaryRegion.description: The primary AWS Region where the secret is stored.
